# BunkWise Technologies

> BunkWise Technologies is a website design and development company based in Jaipur, India, founded by Madhav. It builds research-led, fast websites for businesses, optimised for Google search (SEO) and AI answer engines (AEO and GEO), for clients in India and worldwide. BunkWise also runs free student tools (attendance, SGPA and CGPA calculators) and Android apps.

Key facts:
- Company: BunkWise Technologies, BunkWise (OPC) Private Limited (incorporation in progress)
- Based in: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Works with clients across India and worldwide, online.
- Founder: Madhav (https://github.com/madhavraj840)
- Services: website design, website development, SEO, AEO, GEO, monthly SEO plans
- Prices by region (website packages are one-time; SEO plans are monthly). Full table: https://bunkwise.in/website-design.html#qa-prices
  - India (INR, exclusive of GST): Starter ₹9,999, Business ₹19,999, Growth ₹34,999, Premium ₹59,999; Local SEO ₹7,999/month, Growth SEO ₹14,999/month, Advanced SEO ₹24,999/month
  - United States (USD): Starter $999, Business $1,999, Growth $3,499, Premium $5,999; Local SEO $499/month, Growth SEO $999/month, Advanced SEO $1,799/month
  - United Kingdom (GBP): Starter £799, Business £1,599, Growth £2,799, Premium £4,799; Local SEO £399/month, Growth SEO £799/month, Advanced SEO £1,399/month

- Portfolio: 9 live client websites for restaurants, a dental clinic, a coaching institute, a gym, a solar company and a handicrafts artist.
